description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing 'terms' in an admin interface, including actions for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting terms.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin::Terms
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class for managing terms in the admin interface, providing CRUD operations and list views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to list all terms, providing URLs for viewing, editing, and deleting each term.

methods.name: new_terms
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to initialize a new term with a default 'valid_from' date, then delegates to the edit view.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a term by ID for further actions, or detaches with a not_found error if the term does not exist.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a term if it is not marked to be kept, then redirects to the index.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing or creating a term, setting the submit URL and template.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update or create a term by delegating to 'update_or_create'.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new term, then delegates to 'update_or_create'.

methods.name: update_or_create
methods.description: Private method to save the term's data, either updating existing or inserting new, then redirects accordingly.
